description: Deep green and sharply faceted, prised out of stubborn rock. Mosscairn keeps them in its shoulders.
lore: Beautiful and structurally useless. Emerald is full of its own flaws and every one of them is a line waiting to be asked a question; set it in a blade and the first honest blow finds one. [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]] will take your money for the work and tell you plainly where it is going: handle, never head. A stone in the head takes every blow you strike for as long as you own the thing. A stone in the handle takes only what your own hand gives it. She has never once elaborated on the distinction, and the apprentices who have looked closely at the head of her hammer have never asked her to.
